redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/pipeline.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: scripts/pipeline.mjs: (R17) both python3 calls of the duckdb fallback go through one helper python(args, cwd) = spawnSync('python3', ['-I', ...args], {cwd}); the readerFor probe runs from a fresh mkdtemp dir (removed after), the queryColumns query from the mkdtemp dir that holds the copy. (R9) coverageFloor returns floor = min(CAPS.nodes, max(1, total)) plus the unclamped total; floorLines adds 'The extract holds N, more than the 40-node cap: map the most structural.' when total > CAPS.nodes. (R10) matchUsage matches exact id, then unique prefix only; every other label is an extra row under its own label with a warning; the by-position branch is gone. (R11) new exported privateDir(dir, uid = process.getuid?.()): lstat, create with mode 0o700 when missing, refuse a symlink, a non-directory or another uid's directory, chmod an own directory to 0o700; plan applies it to <tmpdir>/archmap and to <tmpdir>/archmap/<hash> when --work is not given and exits 2 naming the reason. An explicit --work keeps its old behaviour. (R19) introspect compares realpathSync(file) with realpathSync(repoRoot) after the existsSync check, records '<path> is a link that leads outside the repository, so it is not read', and hands the real path to queryColumns. (R20) the terse rung (the last of BRIEF_TRIMS, renamed 'intro, and the labels, floor line, work steps and previous-model line to their gist') now also cuts the previous-model line to '- Previous model (keep its ids): <path>', drops the intro, merges the profile into the area line, shortens the summary and globs labels, leaves kinds of none out of the floor parts and shortens the cap note and the work steps. Measured with p29's input: terminal rung 3717 characters on a first build, 3962 in --update mode with a 211-character previous path (was 4225, over the cap). The ladder comment says what the terminal rung covers. Header comment updated for the work dir and the python isolation. tests/pipeline.test.mjs: p14 rewritten for the new matching (it asserted position matching); p17 expects the clamped floor; p22's python3 stand-ins find the -c argument wherever the flags put it (they read $2, which -I moves); step() takes an optional cwd; new p30 to p33; p29 extended. Red first on the old code with the new tests (node --test tests/pipeline.test.mjs): 33 tests, 27 pass, 6 fail (p14, p29 'update mode: 4225 characters', p30 'finish never imported the duckdb.py of the scanned repo', p31 expected 40 actual 45, p32 mode 493 (0o755) not 448 (0o700), p33 no outside-the-repository skip row). After the fix: 33/33 pass, exit 0. I also ran the full `node --test` once: 408/408 pass. That was more than own-tests asks for, and the orchestrator's run is the one that counts. Dependants: tests/pipeline.test.mjs changed (this task). scripts/usage.mjs is still correct: it only reads the ledger rows, and an unmatched label was already an extra row. tests/commands.test.mjs and tests/skill.test.mjs are still correct (green in the full run). commands/build.md and commands/update.md are still correct: they pass --usage <area>=..., which exact matching serves. skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md is still correct: it says leave --work off and never point it at a symlink, and the floor is 'counted from the extract'. It does not mention the 40-node clamp. It is not in this task's files, so it is not edited. skills/architecture-map/evals/README.md is still correct: it says nothing about these paths. Not done, out of scope: queryColumns still copies <file>.wal when it exists without a realpath check of the .wal itself.
outcome.descriptive: The build driver no longer lets a scanned repo's duckdb.py run or a symlink lead introspection out of the repo, makes its default work dir private and refuses a planted one, books an unmatched --usage label under its own name instead of guessing, clamps the coverage floor to the 40-node cap, and fits the brief under its cap in --update mode too.
